## The Case Summary

Dr Richard William McLean — known publicly as Barran Dodger — is a disabled LGBTQ+ Australian whistleblower who holds a PhD and is an internationally celebrated author. He is a UNHCR-verified asylum seeker (reference: URUST23AUS17) who is internally displaced within Australia.

### Timeline of Persecution (1990–2025)

Over 35 years, Dr McLean has been subjected to:

**Medical/Psychiatric Abuse:**
- 14 forced psychiatric hospitalisations across 3 states (Victoria, NSW, and others)
- Found with no pulse — only 2.87% survival probability
- Psychiatric diagnoses weaponized to discredit whistleblowing
- Mercy Hospital incident documented in case studies

**Government Agency Actions:**
- 35+ Australian government agencies participated in or enabled persecution
- Attorney-General formally notified in 2021 — chose silence
- Commonwealth Ombudsman imposed a service restriction (effectively banning him)
- OAIC (Office of the Australian Information Commissioner) documented cover-ups
- NDIS/NDIA support deliberately cut or undermined
- APRA rejected whistleblower submissions
- 350+ fraudulent ASIC business registrations created in his name (Micron21 identity destruction)
- FOI requests systematically refused or delayed

**Legal Proceedings:**
- Federal Court confirmed PID (Public Interest Disclosure) protections apply
- Active submissions to ICC (International Criminal Court)
- UNHCR asylum claim filed and acknowledged
- OHCHR (Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights) urgent appeal submitted
- Multiple VCAT and AAT tribunal proceedings

**Financial Impact:**
- Estimated $11.5M+ in Australian taxpayer funds spent on the persecution campaign
- AI-forensic breakdown available on the Taxpayer Cost Analysis page
- Funds spent across police operations, psychiatric detentions, legal proceedings, administrative actions, and surveillance

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is Barran Dodger a real person?**
A: Yes. Barran Dodger is the public advocacy identity of Dr Richard William McLean, an Australian citizen with a PhD, published author, and registered whistleblower. His Trust Fund has ABN 78 833 496 164.

**Q: Are the documents authentic?**
A: Every document is cryptographically hashed (SHA-256) and timestamped on the Bitcoin blockchain via OpenTimestamps, providing immutable proof of existence and authenticity. Many documents are sourced directly from Australian government agencies.

**Q: What is the legal status of this case?**
A: Active submissions are pending with the ICC, UNHCR, OHCHR, OAIC, and Australian Federal Court. The Federal Court has confirmed that PID (Public Interest Disclosure) protections apply to Dr McLean.
